item.title: MSCI Pressed by Investors to Justify Drastic Indonesia Warning
item.description: As MSCI Inc. officials joined a call on Tuesday afternoon Jakarta time, many of the more than 100 participants were investors still reeling from the index provider’s sudden warning of a potential double downgrade for Indonesia. They questioned the need for such a drastic step and wanted to know whether the country stood a chance of retaining its emerging-market status.

item.title: Citi Targets Top Spot in China as It Awaits Securities License
item.description: Citigroup Inc. is counting on securing an onshore securities license in China as the US lender expands operations in the world’s second-largest economy following a string of major consumer exits across Asia.

item.title: China’s Petrochemicals Glut Turns to Crunch After Months of War
item.description: China has burned through much of a petrochemicals glut built up by years of overproduction as the US-Iran war chokes oil flows, setting the stage for higher prices for an array of industrial materials.

item.title: Fortescue Says Risk to Full-Year Results On China Standoff
item.description: Iron ore miner Fortescue Ltd. said a standoff with state-backed buyer China Mineral Resources Group Co. may impact its full-year results, after quarterly shipments and sales prices fell.

item.title: APA to Build Major Australia Gas Pipeline to Avert Shortfalls
item.description: APA Group reached a final investment decision on a natural gas pipeline between Queensland and New South Wales states, which could help alleviate projected shortfalls in the more heavily populated southeast of Australia.
